safety_verdicts.content: Patient presents with breathlessness for 2–3 days.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts include SOB/wheeze/cough but do not document the 2–3 day duration of breathlessness.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the 2–3 day duration of breathlessness reduces clarity about the acuity and trajectory of the current asthma exacerbation, which can affect triage urgency and follow-up planning. While not usually immediately dangerous on its own, duration is a key clinical contextualizer for worsening respiratory symptoms.
